verdict.rationale: SvelteKit is the official first-party framework/router from the Svelte team, with docs describing routing-related features (folder-based route hierarchy, SSR/SSG/SPA modes, comparisons to Next/Nuxt) and a CLI (`sv create`) that scaffolds SvelteKit projects. Community feedback confirms real-world use but flags friction (folder-based route/layout organization concerns, dev server rough edges) rather than outright failure. Missing for 10: dedicated deep-dive documentation on the router API itself (route matching, nested layouts, params) and independent corroboration that routing specifically (not SvelteKit broadly) is seamless.
